name: file-explorer
description: A VS Code-style file explorer pane: tree, git decorations, preview and @-mention

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: File and folder icons: emoji (any terminal), nerd (needs a Nerd Font, coloured like VS Code) or ascii

language.title: Help language
language.description: Language of the help (i, /files help): en or ja

mermaid.title: Mermaid diagrams
mermaid.description: Draw ```mermaid blocks in the markdown preview with your own mermaid-cli (mmdc) when it is installed: auto, or off to never run it

pictures.title: Picture converters
pictures.description: Draw JPEG, GIF, WebP and SVG in the terminal by converting them to PNG with a tool you have (sips, ffmpeg, ImageMagick; rsvg-convert for SVG): auto, or off to never run one
